title: Use PixiJS v8 eventMode
why: PixiJS v8 uses eventMode to control hit testing; the legacy interactive flag obscures the intended mode.
suggestion: Set eventMode to 'static' or 'dynamic' according to whether the target moves.
limitations: PixiJS v8 migration checks require an explicit version 8 pixi.js or @pixi dependency in package.json.
Ticker ownership is resolved only for direct receiver.ticker.add/remove calls and inline frame callbacks.
